parameters.content:
## W7 Field feedback
Validates a crew finding, chains it into the hash-chained ledger and saves it. Bad input gets a 400.

**Trigger:** POST https://chlooood.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/terracorridor-v2/finding
**Auth:** Header Auth, credential "TerraCorridor v2 webhook key" (send its header and key; without it the call gets 403)
**Body:** { segment (required), kind (required: dwelling_count | new_structure | ground_movement | no_hazard_found | obligation_met | obligation_missed | unauthorized_work), by (required), value (number, required for dwelling_count), note, withinPrescribedArea, workOrder, id, at }
**Reads:** corridor_ledger
**Writes:** corridor_findings, corridor_ledger
**Next:** Read by **v2 · W9**

Part of the v2 set. Hackathon originals are untouched. Source of truth: github.com/katiescase/terracorridor/workflows. Change the repo and re-import, do not hand-edit.
